name: Uriah
bio: Uriah the priest, along with Zechariah son of Jeberechiah, served as one of Isaiah's two faithful witnesses who recorded the naming of his son Maher-shalal-hash-baz as a sign against Damascus and Samaria (Isaiah 8:2). He is likely the same Uriah the priest who later built an altar to Assyrian gods for King Ahaz in the temple courts (2 Kings 16:10-16).
